title: elymus dahuricus var. excelsus
intro: Elymus dahuricus var. excelsus, commonly known as Dahurian wildrye, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant is known for its traditional medicinal uses, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The health benefits of Dahurian wildrye are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
